zh.title: The Binding of dodo
zh.description: 带着眼泪闯进随机地牢，捡道具、打 Boss，看看这一次能走多远。
zh.controls: WASD 移动 · ↑ ↓ ← → 四向射击
zh.instructions: P 暂停 · E 炸弹 · 空格使用主动道具 · Tab 全图 · I 解锁图鉴。手机使用游戏内的虚拟摇杆与射击按钮。
feedback_questions: 四向射击用起来顺手吗？
前几层的难度会让你想继续吗？
zh.credits: 作者 waterbird-i 负责需求、玩法设计与验收，代码由 AI 辅助完成。
zh.attribution: 据作者说明，本作为《The Binding of Isaac》的致敬性同人作品，与原作者及发行商无关联；图形与音效均由程序生成。

en.title: The Binding of dodo
en.description: Enter a random dungeon armed with tears. Collect items, fight bosses and see how far this run takes you.
en.controls: WASD to move · Arrow keys to shoot in four directions
en.instructions: P to pause · E for bombs · Space to use your active item · Tab for the full map · I for the unlock collection. On mobile, use the in-game virtual sticks and fire buttons.
feedback_questions: Does the early difficulty make you want to keep playing?
en.credits: waterbird-i led the requirements, gameplay design and acceptance testing. The code was developed with AI assistance.
en.attribution: The creator describes this as a fan-made tribute to The Binding of Isaac, with no affiliation to its creators or publisher. Graphics and sound effects are generated procedurally.

zh.title: NIGHTFURY · 极夜狂飙
zh.description: 在霓虹都市、火山、冰原和浮岛间漂移竞速。八张赛道、两款跑车，与五位 AI 对手完成五圈比赛。
zh.controls: W / S 加速刹车 · A / D 转向 · 空格漂移 · Shift 氮气
zh.instructions: 桌面浏览器选择地图与车型，完成五圈比赛。C 切换镜头，R 回到路面，Esc 暂停。漂移和落地奖励可以补充氮气；设置中可选择流畅或精细画质。
zh.credits: Ziang-Chen 创作，使用 Codex 辅助开发。原创代码采用 MIT 许可。
zh.attribution: Aventador 模型：Arion Digital；Veyron 模型：DevPoly3D，CC BY 4.0。Three.js、meshoptimizer：MIT；Draco：Apache-2.0。完整来源及修改说明见游戏源码中的 THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md 与游戏内署名页。地图封面和海报为 ImageGen 概念艺术。
zh.image_caption: 霓虹都市 · 作者提供的实机截图；卡带封面为概念海报
feedback_questions: 首次加载和选图、选车流程是否清楚？
转向、漂移和氮气的手感是否容易掌握？
回环与断桥飞跃失误后，能否顺利回到赛道？
五圈比赛与 AI 追击的难度是否合适？

en.title: NIGHTFURY
en.description: Drift through neon cities, volcanoes, ice fields and floating islands. Choose from eight tracks and two sports cars, then race five AI opponents over five laps.
en.controls: W / S to accelerate and brake · A / D to steer · Space to drift · Shift for nitro
en.instructions: Choose a track and car in a desktop browser and complete five laps. C changes the camera, R returns the car to the road and Esc pauses. Drifting and landing bonuses refill nitro. Choose performance or quality graphics in Settings.
en.credits: Created by Ziang-Chen with development assistance from Codex. Original code is licensed under MIT.
en.attribution: Aventador model: Arion Digital. Veyron model: DevPoly3D, CC BY 4.0. Three.js and meshoptimizer: MIT. Draco: Apache-2.0. See THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md in the game source and the in-game credits for full sources and modifications. Track covers and posters are ImageGen concept art.
en.image_caption: Neon city · Gameplay screenshot supplied by the creator. The cartridge cover is a concept poster.
feedback_questions: Are the first load, track selection and car selection clear?
Are steering, drifting and nitro easy to learn?
Can you recover smoothly after missing a loop or broken-bridge jump?
Are the five-lap race and AI opponents appropriately challenging?

zh.title: 你脏了 · 微缩清剿（蟑螂大作战）
zh.description: 在房间里以蟑螂般的大小生存，选择武器、叠加符文，寻找虫母。支持键盘和触屏摇杆，自动攻击。
zh.image_caption: 2026-09-15 实际打开游戏后截取的标题与试玩画面。

en.title: Dirty Room · Cockroach Skirmish
en.description: Survive at cockroach size inside a room. Pick weapons, stack runes and hunt down the brood mother. Supports keyboard and touch-stick controls with automatic attacks.
en.image_caption: Title screen and gameplay captured from the running game on September 15, 2026.

zh.title: SNKRX · Godot 非官方复刻试玩
zh.description: SNKRX 的 Godot 非官方复刻预览。页面提供新手快速试玩、普通开局与操作说明，完整还原尚未完成。原作与配乐署名见试玩页。
zh.image_caption: 2026-09-15 实际试玩截图。非官方复刻，完整还原尚未完成。

en.title: SNKRX · Unofficial Godot Playtest
en.description: An unofficial Godot recreation of SNKRX. The preview offers a quick tutorial run, a standard start and controls. The recreation is not yet complete. Original game and music credits are listed on the playtest page.
en.image_caption: Gameplay captured on September 15, 2026. This unofficial recreation is not yet complete.

zh.title: HARBOR STORIES · 日落边境 VI
zh.description: 从港口行动开始，也可以自由探索城市，驾驶汽车、快艇和飞机。提供地面突击、空战和委托任务入口。
zh.image_caption: 2026-09-15 自由探索模式实机截图。

en.title: HARBOR STORIES · Sunset Frontier VI
en.description: Start with a harbor mission, or explore the city freely by car, speedboat and aircraft. Includes ground assaults, air combat and contracts.

zh.title: 风之书的旅途
zh.description: 横版探索内测试玩。移动、二段跳、旋风转身，寻找散落的风之书，再回到图书馆阅读。
zh.image_caption: 2026-09-15 实际打开游戏后截取的试玩画面。

en.title: Wind Book Journey
en.description: A side-scrolling exploration playtest. Move, double-jump and spin through the world to find scattered wind books, then return to the library to read them.
en.image_caption: Gameplay captured from the running game on September 15, 2026.

zh.title: 铁甲洪流 · 重启防线
zh.description: 驾驶守备坦克，守住基地、重新连接失联的防线节点。提供单人行动与本地双人模式，移动时自动开火。
zh.image_caption: 2026-09-15 游戏标题封面与灰线哨站战役实机截图。

en.title: Iron Swarm · Defense Reboot
en.description: Drive a defense tank, protect the base and reconnect lost defense nodes. Includes solo and local two-player modes, with automatic fire while moving.
en.image_caption: Title screen and Greyline Outpost campaign gameplay captured on September 15, 2026.
